The rest of the powder includes maltodextrin, gum arabic, xanthan gum, and undisclosed "natural flavour." None of it is listed on the menu. None of it is disclosed to customers. The powder exists for one reason — to keep your blended drink from separating after it's made. A texture fix. That's it. Starbucks chose a lung-damaging industrial compound over a drink that separates slightly faster. Their workers are reporting symptoms on every shift.
